sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 176693"
sources.quote: HD 176693, also known as Kepler-408, is a star with a close orbiting exoplanet in the northern constellation of Draco.

introduction.text: Its radius and temperature follow Marcy et al. 2014.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "HD 176693"
sources.quote: It is located at a distance of 291 light years from the Sun based on parallax measurements, but it is drifting closer with a radial velocity of −55 km/s.
